findings.note: HB 1109 lists Dunahoo among its authors. It would amend Code Section 21-2-417 so that a driver's license or ID card issued to a noncitizen is not proper identification to present to a poll worker, and would require such cards to carry the words "BEARER NOT A U.S. CITIZEN - NOT VOTER ID" and a number prefix "NC". Hopper date 1/29/2026 (from policyrisk.com/state-bill/GA-HB1109-2025-2026); last action second reading 2/3/2026.
